messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), how often will the IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane at position 13 have to be verified in 2028?

response.text: Dato che l'azienda opera in aree minerarie (settore estrattivo), con quale frequenza il carroponte a ponte IGEA-PRIM da 5 t in posizione 13 dovrà essere verificato nel 2028?
